detailed_descriptions.en: ✨ Pre-Order Deluxe or Ultimate Edition to get 5 days early access! ✨ Live life on the tracks and discover the joy of train simulation. Whether looking for a relaxing run on the rails or seeking the thrill of mastering your virtual train driver career, find your way in Train Sim World 7 across a range of iconic routes and locomotives. 🌴 THE SUNSHINE STATE AWAITS ☀️ Surf the rails of Miami, Fort Lauderdale and more for the first time with FLORIDA TRI-RAIL, featuring the Tri-Rail BL36PH, F40PH and Rotem cars. Work local freight with CSX motive power and switch around stones with the Dura-Max Rock Hopper. DELUXE EDITION: Geep Duty awaits as you put additional equipment to work across the rails of Miami with the TRI-RAIL GP49H-3. 🍃 RUN TO THE YORKSHIRE HILLS 🐑 Head for the north of England and through the quaint hills of Yorkshire with the AIREDALE & WHARFEDALE NETWORK, featuring the Northern BR Class 331 & LNER Azuma. Run the Rylstone quarry industry with the BR Class 66 & HYA Limestone Hopper. DELUXE EDITION: Make a splash with extra EMU variety as you wade across the rails in the NORTHERN BR CLASS 333. 🏰 BAVARIA BOUND ⛰️ Wind your way around the low peaks of Bavaria on thrilling long-distance & regional services with BAHNSTRECKE NÜRNBERG - WÜRZBURG in the DB BR 440, DB BR 442 and DB BR 193 Vectron. DELUXE EDITION: Accelerate across high-speed German rails in style with the ultra-modern and fan-favourite DB BR 412 ICE 4! 🛠️ NEW FEATURES & PC-EXCLUSIVE ENHANCEMENTS 🖥️ Find new ways to cart cargo with FREIGHT HAULER📦. Marshall freight to its destination free from instructions or schedules. It’s your choices, your strategy, as freight cars populate the route, each one looking for a home. Switch, shunt and haul them all as you see fit. The forecast calls to you with LIVE WEATHER🌤️, have in-game weather powered by real-time location-specific data, getting you deep into the action exactly as it’s happening out in the World. The next job awaits, no matter the meteorology. Take things a step further with enhanced realism by enabling safety systems by default! Now, should you choose to, step into the cab and find that the likes of AWS, PZB and more are already enabled - which is often the case for taking over trains - or keep things as they are if you prefer a relaxing run or still want to enable them yourself. Take things beyond Ultra with an all-new “Epic” settings level, taking better advantage of modern hardware by extending draw distances and improving shadow quality. On top of that, Train Sim World 7 now runs on DirectX 12, supports DLSS 4.5 adding DLAA and upscaling, as well as FSR 4 for upscaling and frame generation. Make visuals the best they can be with an all-new Enhanced Lighting option for all TOD4 routes.✅ Right away, driver! On trains which have guards, they can now open and close the doors, increasing realism for driver-guard operations. 🎨 FIND YOUR WAY 📸 With a diverse array of features such as Photo Mode, Route Hopping and more, embark on your own journey, in your own way. 🐦 FREE ROAM: Choose your path and explore any route with your favourite trains! Have the rails entirely to yourself or mix in with the timetable, running between scheduled services on your own ad hoc journeys. 👨‍✈️ CONDUCTOR MODE: Tickets please! Enjoy a different pace on conductor-operated trains - check tickets between each station and work the passenger doors to safely dispatch your service. Take a moment to enjoy the scenery on longer stretches between stations. 👨‍🎨 CREATORS CLUB: Get creative and customise your experience! Use LIVERY DESIGNER to make your dream designs come to life, and FORMATION DESIGNER to make up custom trains using your collection. Put creations to use with Free Roam & SCENARIO PLANNER, or share your creations online! (Dovetail Live sign-up required). 🚂 YOUR COLLECTION, YOUR WAY 🚅 Enter the hobby with different editions: FREE STARTER EDITION introduces you to Train Sim World 7 with the Training Center. STANDARD EDITION🥉 comes with the 3 new routes, DELUXE EDITION🥈 also comes with additional new trains, and ULTIMATE EDITION🥇 comes with an additional set of TSW7 Compatible content. “TSW Compatible” content released for a previous Train Sim World - features may remain unchanged from the original release and may not make use of all newer core features. Look forward to a great variety of experiences from multiple countries. Explore the many existing routes and locos and get ready for new challenges as the world of train simulation ever expands. Please Note: The Train Sim World 7 UI is localised into English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Russian, Simplified Chinese and Japanese. Localisation on Add-On content varies depending on the individual content.🌎

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
✨Pre-Order Deluxe or Ultimate Edition to get 5 days early access!✨

Live life on the tracks and discover the joy of train simulation. Whether looking for a relaxing run on the rails or seeking the thrill of mastering your virtual train driver career, find your way in Train Sim World 7 across a range of iconic routes and locomotives.

🌴 THE SUNSHINE STATE AWAITS ☀️



Surf the rails of Miami, Fort Lauderdale and more for the first time with FLORIDA TRI-RAIL, featuring the Tri-Rail BL36PH, F40PH and Rotem cars. Work local freight with CSX motive power and switch around stones with the Dura-Max Rock Hopper.

DELUXE EDITION: Geep Duty awaits as you put additional equipment to work across the rails of Miami with the TRI-RAIL GP49H-3. 

🍃 RUN TO THE YORKSHIRE HILLS 🐑



Head for the north of England and through the quaint hills of Yorkshire with the AIREDALE & WHARFEDALE NETWORK, featuring the Northern BR Class 331 & LNER Azuma. Run the Rylstone quarry industry with the BR Class 66 & HYA Limestone Hopper.

DELUXE EDITION: Make a splash with extra EMU variety as you wade across the rails in the NORTHERN BR CLASS 333. 

🏰 BAVARIA BOUND ⛰️



Wind your way around the low peaks of Bavaria on thrilling long-distance & regional services with BAHNSTRECKE NÜRNBERG - WÜRZBURG in the DB BR 440, DB BR 442 and DB BR 193 Vectron.

DELUXE EDITION: Accelerate across high-speed German rails in style with the ultra-modern and fan-favourite DB BR 412 ICE 4! 

🛠️ NEW FEATURES & PC-EXCLUSIVE ENHANCEMENTS 🖥️



Find new ways to cart cargo with FREIGHT HAULER📦. Marshall freight to its destination free from instructions or schedules. It’s your choices, your strategy, as freight cars populate the route, each one looking for a home. Switch, shunt and haul them all as you see fit.

The forecast calls to you with LIVE WEATHER🌤️, have in-game weather powered by real-time location-specific data, getting you deep into the action exactly as it’s happening out in the World. The next job awaits, no matter the meteorology.

Take things a step further with enhanced realism by enabling safety systems by default! Now, should you choose to, step into the cab and find that the likes of AWS, PZB and more are already enabled - which is often the case for taking over trains - or keep things as they are if you prefer a relaxing run or still want to enable them yourself.

Take things beyond Ultra with an all-new “Epic” settings level, taking better advantage of modern hardware by extending draw distances and improving shadow quality. On top of that, Train Sim World 7 now runs on DirectX 12, supports DLSS 4.5 adding DLAA and upscaling, as well as FSR 4 for upscaling and frame generation. Make visuals the best they can be with an all-new Enhanced Lighting option for all TOD4 routes.✅

Right away, driver! On trains which have guards, they can now open and close the doors, increasing realism for driver-guard operations.

🎨 FIND YOUR WAY 📸



With a diverse array of features such as Photo Mode, Route Hopping and more, embark on your own journey, in your own way.

🐦 FREE ROAM: Choose your path and explore any route with your favourite trains! Have the rails entirely to yourself or mix in with the timetable, running between scheduled services on your own ad hoc journeys.

👨‍✈️ CONDUCTOR MODE: Tickets please! Enjoy a different pace on conductor-operated trains - check tickets between each station and work the passenger doors to safely dispatch your service. Take a moment to enjoy the scenery on longer stretches between stations.

👨‍🎨 CREATORS CLUB: Get creative and customise your experience! Use LIVERY DESIGNER to make your dream designs come to life, and FORMATION DESIGNER to make up custom trains using your collection. Put creations to use with Free Roam & SCENARIO PLANNER, or share your creations online! (Dovetail Live sign-up required).

🚂 YOUR COLLECTION, YOUR WAY 🚅


Enter the hobby with different editions:

FREE STARTER EDITION introduces you to Train Sim World 7 with the Training Center.

STANDARD EDITION🥉 comes with the 3 new routes, DELUXE EDITION🥈 also comes with additional new trains, and ULTIMATE EDITION🥇 comes with an additional set of TSW7 Compatible content.



“TSW Compatible” content released for a previous Train Sim World - features may remain unchanged from the original release and may not make use of all newer core features.

Look forward to a great variety of experiences from multiple countries. Explore the many existing routes and locos and get ready for new challenges as the world of train simulation ever expands.

Please Note: The Train Sim World 7 UI is localised into English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Russian, Simplified Chinese and Japanese. Localisation on Add-On content varies depending on the individual content.🌎
